digest_format.framing:
<len>:<str>
 for strings, <N>
 for counts, canonical decimal integers, deterministic key sorting
digest_format.collision_resistance: Strictly prevents delimiter injection and duplicate readset/change partition attacks

transport.frame: Unsigned big-endian 32-bit length header followed by exactly that many UTF-8 JSON bytes

commands.semantics: Atomic exclusive creation and schema+meta initialization within single transaction, followed by fsync_dir
Bounded read of up to 64 keys within single read transaction with aggregate value length enforcement
Bounded pagination of inbox/ namespace up to limit <= 100 with strictly validated after_key cursor
Idempotency receipt lookup for operation reconciliation after uncertain outcomes
Atomic CAS transaction with read-set assertions, replay detection, capacity reservation and append-only receipt

validation.schemas: Exact per-command allowed fields; unknown fields rejected with unknown_json_field
validation.optional_field_typing: Optional fields distinguish absent, present with allowed type, and invalid-present; non-string db_path, non-string/non-hex expected_sha256, non-string after_key, non-integer limit strictly rejected without default fallback
validation.unicode_utf8: Strict RFC 3629 Unicode scalar validation on input wire frames and base64-decoded values; rejects surrogates (0xD800..0xDFFF), overlong bytes, and invalid bytes such as 0xFF
validation.json_strictness: Strict RFC 8259 parser rejecting Yojson extensions, comments, unescaped control chars, lone surrogates, and duplicate keys; requires base64-decoded values and summary_json to be valid standard JSON
validation.version_hash_invariants: v = 0 implies sha == '' (or absent/null); v > 0 implies sha is 64-hex lowercase; invalid types rejected
validation.duplicates: Duplicate read-set keys rejected with duplicate_read_set_key; duplicate changes rejected with duplicate_change_key; duplicate JSON keys rejected with duplicate_json_keys

security.ancestor_confinement: Full ancestor path validation using Unix.lstat from / to parent directory; symlinks forbidden (db_path_symlink); non-foreign-writable (st_perm land 0o022 == 0) enforced on all ancestors regardless of owner UID; only exact root-owned sticky /tmp (st_uid == 0 && st_perm land 0o1000 <> 0) exempt; own-UID world-writable ancestor strictly rejected; dedicated 0700 immediate parent
security.redaction: No token, path, row value, or request body reflection in error strings

durability.initialization: Atomic BEGIN IMMEDIATE ... COMMIT encompassing schema and 5 meta entries; explicit rollback on failure; fsync_dir after commit; post-commit failure returns commit_uncertain; no deletion of ambiguous DB files
durability.statement_cleanup: Guaranteed Sqlite3.finalize on all 15 statement execution paths via with_prepared_stmt wrapper
durability.uncertainty_reconciliation: Failures during COMMIT or post-commit return commit_uncertain; lookup_operation reconciles committed receipts
durability.crash_recovery: Verified under actual SIGKILL child termination across 5 internal barriers (Init_after_ddl, Init_after_meta, Apply_between_rows, Apply_pre_commit, Apply_post_commit_pre_reply) proving clean WAL rollback and durable receipt replay
